news.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
news.body: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings.

news.title: Greptile 用 AI 测试补充代码审查
news.body: 客户案例介绍通过界面操作检查应用行为，例如不同屏幕尺寸下的功能问题，并结合安全分析。自动发现仍需验证，案例不等于所有缺陷均能检出。
news.title_original: Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
news.body_original: How Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra to test user workflows, Daybreak to strengthen security, and Codex to reduce rework.

news.title: MIT 在纽约气候周连接跨领域合作网络
news.body: 报道介绍 MIT 团队参与人工智能、气候创新及产业合作讨论。活动强调多方协作，不代表会上讨论的技术已产生可量化减排成果。
news.title_original: At New York Climate Week 2026, MIT connects with a global network
news.body_original: A cross-section of the MIT community convened discussions on topics ranging from data centers and super pollutants to agriculture and education.

news.title: OpenAI 探索与学界共同理解模型生成的研究结果
news.body: 公告介绍数学、计算机科学和物理方向的材料及不同发布安排，并将稿件视为待学界理解的原始研究数据。不能把公告中的发现主张直接写成已获独立验证的定论。
news.title_original: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
news.body_original: OpenAI shares model results on the Kakeya conjecture, Exponential Time Hypothesis, and quantum chromodynamics—and how researchers can verify and build on them.

news.title: CodeRabbit 用模型辅助跨代码库安全调查
news.body: 案例介绍关联文件、依赖与共享组件的风险分析，并对选定问题在隔离环境中验证及提出修复。最终是否发布修改仍由人工审核决定。
news.title_original: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
news.body_original: CodeRabbit uses GPT-6.1 Sol to investigate security risks across complex codebases. Its security agent helps developers review findings and proposed fixes.

news.title: OpenAI 发布按工作活动划分的 ChatGPT 使用数据
news.body: 数据覆盖近百国的 165 类工作活动，支持季度比较与经济研究。消息使用分布不能直接解释为就业替代、劳动生产率或因果影响。
news.body_original: Explore OpenAI Signals data on 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how people use ChatGPT for work and how usage changes over time.

news.title: Fanatics 用 AI 更新商品搭配推荐
news.body: 案例介绍结合商品、库存和搭配规则生成推荐，并由团队反馈迭代。互动提升属于企业自报指标，不等于销售或利润增长已获独立证实。
news.title_original: How Fanatics and OpenAI streamline the fan experience
news.body_original: Fanatics uses OpenAI to help fans complete their game-day outfits with Shop the Look. Testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products showed 10% higher engagement.

news.title: OpenAI 分享 Ultrafast 辅助故障调查案例
news.body: 内部团队使用快速模型并行查找潜在原因、汇总信息，缩短部分调查流程。节时数字来自内部经验，工具仍是工程师的调查助手。
news.title_original: How Ultrafast cut incident investigation from hours to minutes at OpenAI
news.body_original: See how OpenAI engineers use Codex Ultrafast to investigate incidents in minutes. Explore faster security analysis, code refactoring, and daily workflows.

news.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra
news.body: 公告介绍面向视觉理解、计算机操作和写作的模型，并报告指定评测中的能力与成本表现。基准结果不保证所有应用任务都同样准确或高效。
news.body_original: Bringing fast and capable computer use to everyone

news.title: Google 回顾 AI 结核病筛查从研究走向基层的进展
news.body: 文章介绍胸部影像筛查、前瞻性临床研究及与当地合作伙伴推进部署的路径，也讨论 MedGemma 等开放模型。筛查用于发现需要进一步检测的人群，不能等同于单凭 AI 确诊或各地区均已获准使用。
news.title_original: Bringing foundational models to the front lines of TB screening

news.title: Martha Minow 在 MIT 讨论 AI 与民主的关系
news.body: 讲座从教育、公民参与和制度信任等角度讨论 AI 可能带来的侵蚀与支持作用。这是法律学者的公共论述，不应当作已获因果验证的统一社会结论。
news.title_original: At MIT, Martha Minow speaks on sustaining democracy, both by using and overcoming AI
news.body_original: In Compton Lecture, the distinguished legal scholar warns of potential “loss of the Enlightenment” while suggesting ways innovations can meet our civic and cultural needs.

news.title: OpenAI 介绍 Habitat 在线存储的扩展经验
news.body: 文章讨论 Cosmos DB 多租户隔离、数据移动、热点限流及全球缓存等设计权衡。经验来自其自身大规模工作负载，不意味着相同架构适用于所有系统。
news.title_original: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
news.body_original: Learn how OpenAI scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT.

news.title: MIT 人文社科学院周年活动讨论 AI 与人的理解
news.body: 报道回顾 9 月研讨会中对人文学科、教育和技术社会影响的讨论。内容是学术活动观点汇集，不是新的 AI 性能或社会效果实验。
news.title_original: Reinforcing the value of human understanding at MIT
news.body_original: During the School of Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences’ 75th Anniversary Symposium, President Sally Kornbluth said “MIT has never needed your particular insight and guidance more than we do now.”

Foundation models extend this capability across the periodic table but inherit the thermodynamic description of the electronic structure methods used to generate their training data. We introduce an additive thermodynamic correction layer that shifts phase free energies towards an assessed reference without retraining or modifying the base potential. papers.body: arXiv:2610.34642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning across materials science, chemistry, energy, and medicine increasingly relies on literature-extracted datasets due to a lack of curated databases. Drawing on our work building an electro-optic property database, we present a taxonomy of errors organized by their origin and signatures, alongside a layered framework for error detection. papers.body: arXiv:2503.15389v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In solid acid electrolytes CsH$_2$PO$_4$ and CsHSO$_4$, the origin of fast proton conduction has long been debated, attributed either to local proton hopping or to polyanion rotation. However, the precise role of polyanion rotation and its interplay with proton hopping remained unresolved. Nanosecond-scale molecular dynamics simulations, driven by equivariant neural network force fields, reveal a nuanced proton slingshot mechanism: protons are first carried by rotating polyanions, followed by O-H bond reorientation, and the combined motion enables long-range jumps.
